benchmarks.name: Traditional Chinese Quality Benchmark
benchmarks.summary: Measures how clean a tool's Traditional Chinese output is against Taiwan usage norms: simplified-character residue, mainland-China wording, and terminology consistency. Fixed 24-segment corpus (marketing, UI strings, game dialogue, customer support), deterministic scoring script, raw outputs archived per run.

categories.label: Website Localization
categories.blurb: Plugins, proxies and services that translate a whole website and serve each language under its own URLs.

categories.label: Translation Management Systems
categories.blurb: Platforms that manage localization work: translation memory, terminology, workflow, vendors and QA. They coordinate translation rather than generate it.

categories.label: Localization Service Platforms

tools.name: Weglot
tools.tagline: Website translation that serves each language under its own URLs, with an editing layer on top.
tools.best_for: Site owners who need a multilingual website live quickly, from personal sites to high-traffic stores (vendor's own tier positioning).
tools.free_tier: Free plan: 2,000 total words, 1 translated language
tools.trial: 14-day free trial of paid plans, no credit card required
tools.description: Weglot detects a website's content, translates it, and serves each language version under its own URL structure with multilingual SEO metadata. A first machine-translated layer can be edited by humans in a visual editor, and professional translators can be ordered inside the product.
tools.pricing_model: Subscription by total translated words × languages. USD estimates shown by the vendor: $17 / $32 / $87 / $329 / $769. Annual billing gives 2 months free.

tools.name: Crowdin
tools.tagline: Localization platform for software and games, with unlimited translator seats on every plan.
tools.best_for: Indie developers and open-source projects (Free/Pro) up to multi-product organizations (Team+/Business), per the vendor's plan structure.
tools.free_tier: Free plan: 60,000 hosted words, 1 private project, unlimited translators
tools.trial: 14-day free trial of Team; 30-day trial of Enterprise (vendor FAQ)
tools.description: Crowdin is a cloud localization platform for software, apps, games and documentation. Teams manage strings and files, translation memory and glossaries, invite translators or crowdsource, and connect repositories and design tools through integrations.
tools.pricing_model: Subscription metered by hosted words and manager seats; translator seats unlimited on every plan. Prices exclude VAT/GST.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 60,000 hosted words · 1 private project · unlimited translators

tools.name: Phrase
tools.tagline: Enterprise localization suite combining a full TMS with software-string management.
tools.best_for: Freelancers and LSPs (Freelancer/Professional), product teams (Software UI/UX), and enterprises running multi-vendor programs (Team and above).
tools.description: Phrase is a localization platform suite (Phrase TMS, formerly Memsource, plus Phrase Strings) covering CAT editing, translation memory, term bases, QA, workflow automation and vendor management for software and business content.
tools.pricing_model: Annual subscription by product capacities (processed words, managed words, MT units) and seats.

plans.name: Software UI/UX
plans.note: For product teams · Strings seats included

tools.name: Lokalise
tools.tagline: TMS built around developer and design workflows, with in-context editing.
tools.best_for: Product and marketing teams localizing apps and websites who want strong design-tool and repository integrations.
tools.free_tier: No free plan — 14-day trial only (free for qualifying open-source nonprofits on request)
tools.trial: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
tools.description: Lokalise is a translation management system for apps, websites, games and marketing content, with a collaborative editor, translation memory, glossaries, in-context previews, screenshots, and 60+ integrations including GitHub, Figma and content platforms.
tools.pricing_model: Subscription by tier, metered by allowances such as hosted words, projects, languages and seats.

tools.name: Smartling
tools.tagline: Enterprise TMS bundled with buy-it-here translation services, priced per word.
tools.best_for: Enterprises that want the platform and the translation services from one vendor, including regulated, high-volume programs.
tools.free_tier: Core tier is 'free to start' (vendor plans page); translation services are metered per word
tools.description: Smartling is an enterprise translation management platform combined with a language-services business: customers can run their own translators or buy machine, AI-assisted and human translation per word inside the same system.
tools.pricing_model: Platform tiers plus per-word service pricing; upper platform tiers are sales-led.

plans.name: Core
plans.note: Basic workflow and project management · TM for 180 days

tools.name: DeepL
tools.tagline: Machine translation service with a strong reputation in European languages, plus an API.
tools.best_for: Individuals and teams who want high-quality European-language machine translation and document translation with data-protection guarantees.
tools.trial: 30-day free trial of Individual and Team plans
tools.description: DeepL is a machine translation service known for European-language quality, offered as a web/app translator, document translation, and an API. Paid plans add glossaries, tone control, larger character allowances and a no-training-on-your-data commitment.
tools.pricing_model: Subscription per user with monthly character allowances; prices shown in EUR on the vendor's pricing page.

plans.name: Business / Enterprise
plans.note: Unlimited characters (per vendor terms) · custom options

tools.name: Google Translate
tools.tagline: The default machine translation engine — free on the web, per-character pricing on the API.
tools.best_for: High-volume, cost-sensitive translation via API, and everyday web translation where Traditional Chinese output will be human-reviewed.
tools.free_tier: Consumer translator is free; Cloud Translation includes 500,000 characters/month free
tools.description: Google Translate is the world's most-used machine translation service, available as a free web/app translator and as Cloud Translation API (Basic NMT and Advanced, including LLM-based translation) priced per character.
tools.pricing_model: Consumer product is free; the API is metered per character with a monthly free allowance.

plans.name: Consumer (web/app)
plans.note: The endpoint family used in our benchmark run

plans.name: Cloud Translation — NMT
plans.note: First 500,000 characters/month free (as a monthly credit)

plans.name: Cloud Translation — Translation LLM
plans.note: $10 per million input + $10 per million output characters

tools.name: Microsoft Translator
tools.tagline: Azure's translation API with the largest free tier in its class.
tools.best_for: Microsoft-stack organizations and API users who want a large free monthly allowance before paying per character.
tools.starting_price: Free tier 2M chars/mo · then $10 per million characters
tools.free_tier: F0 free tier: 2 million characters/month free
tools.description: Microsoft Translator (Azure Translator in Foundry Tools) is Microsoft's machine translation API: text and document translation, language detection, transliteration and custom models trained on your own parallel data.
tools.pricing_model: Per-character API pricing with a generous free tier; commitment tiers lower the per-million rate at volume.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.tagline: Google's LLM, used as an instruction-following translation engine via API.
tools.best_for: Teams already using LLM APIs who want translation quality that follows instructions (glossaries, tone) without a separate MT contract.
tools.free_tier: Free tier available through Google AI Studio / Gemini API
tools.description: Gemini is Google's large language model family, accessible through Google AI Studio and the Gemini API. Used as a translation engine, it takes natural-language instructions — target variety, glossary and tone — in the same call as the source text.
tools.pricing_model: Token-based API pricing with a free tier.

plans.name: API free tier
plans.note: Rate-limited; the tier used for our benchmark run

plans.name: API paid tiers
plans.note: Per-token pricing on Google's official pricing page

tools.name: MyMemory
tools.tagline: Translation-memory API with a free daily quota, by Translated.
tools.best_for: Developers who need a free, low-volume translation-memory API and can work within a small daily quota.
tools.free_tier: Free anonymous API usage: 5,000 characters/day (official usage-limits document)
tools.description: MyMemory is a translation-memory service by Translated: it searches a large archive of human translations and falls back to machine translation, exposed through a free API with daily usage limits and paid plans via RapidAPI.
tools.pricing_model: Free daily quota; paid volume through RapidAPI.

tools.name: Groq
tools.tagline: High-speed LLM inference API — openai/gpt-oss-120b, benchmarked here as a translation engine.
tools.best_for: Developers who want LLM translation through a fast API with a free tier, and can work with open-weight models.
tools.description: Groq is an AI inference platform that serves open and proprietary LLMs through an API, including a free tier. In this benchmark its hosted openai/gpt-oss-120b model was run as a translation engine on the same corpus and the same neutral prompt as every other AI engine.
tools.pricing_model: API with a free tier; paid usage is token-based (see Groq's official site for current rates).

plans.name: API free tier
plans.note: Rate-limited; the tier used for our benchmark run

plans.name: API paid tiers
plans.note: Per-token pricing on the vendor's site

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.tagline: A single API routing to many LLMs, including free-tier models.
tools.best_for: Developers who want to compare or switch LLM translation engines through one API.
tools.description: OpenRouter provides one API interface to a large catalog of large language models from many providers, including free-tier models, with per-model token pricing.
tools.pricing_model: Token-based, varies by model; free models available.
